answer: An agent collective suppresses Sybil attacks using optomechanical interferometry. Nodes verify identity by tracking microscopic beam wander from a collimated laser reflected off a resonant mirror inside a test bench isolated with dense walnut wood. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware expense of maintaining dedicated precision optoelectronics per identity. However, ambient thermal drafts and airborne particulates induce optical scattering, producing occasional false rejections.
